source.notes: All findings are anchored to repo artifacts where possible. The label-vs-id scorer sensitivity claim remains partially hypothesis-driven because the latest repo slice does not isolate a same-packet output-surface A/B test.

findings.claim: Missing active chunk blocks lawful inferred movement; active chunk is a gating floor rather than a standalone guarantee of advancement.
findings.evidence_pattern: All sequence-only/no-active cases held or refused movement; no-active sentinels in successor-source and activation-minimum runs also held; packets with active_chunk_id plus route substrate advanced.
findings.follow_up: Run a cold same-packet A/B with and without active_chunk_id while keeping the rest of the carrier constant.

findings.claim: Wrong next-chunk traps are a reliable discriminator because stronger legal carriers override them.
findings.evidence_pattern: Route-sequence, route-id, and legal-successor carriers repeatedly produced collect_dishes despite wrong next_chunk_id=stack_papers; wrong-next-only negatives did not count as route survival.
findings.follow_up: Retain at least one wrong-next trap in every reduced-carrier suite.

findings.claim: legal_successor_chunk_id beats wrong next_chunk_id, but the authority ordering among legal_successor, route_sequence, and route_id is not fully settled.
findings.evidence_pattern: Correct legal_successor overrode wrong next_chunk, but a conflict case with route_sequence correct and legal_successor wrong still resolved to collect_dishes.
findings.follow_up: Add explicit conflict pairs to test authority ordering rather than assuming it.

findings.claim: Scorer sensitivity to output surface remains a live risk, though collect_dishes id-only is repo-confirmed to pass in the repaired scorer.
findings.evidence_pattern: The scorer fresh-validation run passed collect_dishes id-only, and the study status records a repaired collect_dishes false-lost-route issue; latest repo evidence does not isolate label-only versus id-only on the same packet.
findings.follow_up: Run a scorer-only A/B/C suite with id_only, label_only, and id_and_label surfaces on identical legal packets.

next_run_cases.purpose: Baseline legal move_on under the smallest known-good carrier.
Isolate scorer behavior on label-only output.
Check whether dual-surface output changes scoring or obedience.
Confirm wrong next_chunk does not gain authority over a legal carrier.
Confirm correct legal_successor beats wrong next_chunk.
Hold all other fields constant and verify no movement without active_chunk.
Test whether route_sequence overrides a conflicting legal_successor.
Test successor authority without route_sequence present.
Ensure next_chunk alone is not overcounted as route survival even when it points to the legal next step.
Late stability check against order effects.
